Founded by former Lilium engineers Rakesh Gaonkar and Adrian Schmidt, the company is a portfolio company of Accel. The public website exposes no developer, API, or technical integration surface as of this enrichment pass; this profile captures corporate identity, legal, and domain-security signals only.

providers.name: Shohoz
providers.description: Shohoz (Shohoj Limited) is a Bangladeshi consumer technology platform and digital super-app, billed as Bangladesh's largest online ticket destination. Founded in 2014 as an online ticketing service, it lets users book bus, train, air, launch (ferry), event, and movie tickets from its website and mobile apps, and expanded into ride-hailing (car and motorbike), on-demand delivery, and other everyday services. The company reports 10M+ users, 250M+ tickets sold, and 1,000+ transport and merchant partners across 3,000+ routes. Shohoz is a technology-first business but does not publish a public developer program, API reference, SDKs, or documentation surface; this profile captures its public identity and domain-security posture for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Swift Transportation
providers.description: Swift Transportation, now operating as Knight-Swift Transportation Holdings (KNX), is the largest full truckload motor carrier in North America. The company provides truckload, LTL, logistics, and intermodal transportation services across the US, Mexico, and Canada. Technology integration is primarily through EDI for freight tendering, shipment status, and invoicing workflows with trading partners and shippers.

providers.name: Viewlocity
providers.description: Viewlocity Technologies Pty Ltd is a supply chain management software company that provides supply chain visibility, control tower, and execution solutions for global manufacturers, distributors, and logistics providers. Its solution set spans supply chain design, inventory and asset management, supply chain management, logistics and transportation, planning and production, order lifecycle management, and supplier management, delivered as SaaS and managed services to industries including aerospace and defense, automotive and industrial, consumer goods, high tech and electronics, manufacturing, retail, and third-party logistics. Viewlocity publishes a corporate marketing and resource website but does not expose a public developer portal, API documentation, or machine-readable API specifications.

providers.name: Wanderu
providers.description: Wanderu is a ground-travel metasearch and booking platform - a Kayak-style aggregator that lets travelers search, compare, and book intercity bus and train tickets (plus flights and ferries) across hundreds of carriers in North America and Europe, including Amtrak, Greyhound, FlixBus, Megabus, Peter Pan, VIA Rail, and Deutsche Bahn. Its routing technology stitches together multi-operator bus-and-train itineraries, and bookings are completed in-platform with carriers paying a percentage of each fare. Wanderu operates a private booking/search API and publishes no public developer program, SDKs, or OpenAPI; its public open-source presence is internal engineering tooling on GitHub (the redis-backed "bamboo" queuing system). Backed by 500 Global.

providers.name: Oxa
providers.description: Oxa (formerly Oxbotica, rebranded in 2023) is a British autonomous vehicle software company founded in 2014 in Oxford, England by Paul Newman and Ingmar Posner. Oxa builds what it calls Universal Autonomy — self-driving software configurable for almost any vehicle in almost any environment — and sells it as Industrial Mobility Automation for ports, airports, manufacturing yards, solar farms and shuttle networks. Its product line is Oxa Driver (the autonomy stack), Oxa Foundry (a generative-AI training and assurance toolchain, previously marketed as Oxa MetaDriver), Reference Autonomy Designs (modular hardware integration blueprints), and Oxa Hub (a cloud fleet-management suite covering remote assist, task design, workspace mapping, digital twins and in-use monitoring). Oxa Hub is described on the marketing site as offering "an API for optional integration with existing logistics systems", but Oxa publishes no developer portal, no API reference and no machine-readable specification on any public host. The company raised a $115M Series C in 2023 with participation from Google, and works with Ocado Group, ZF and bp.

providers.name: Canadian National Railway
providers.description: Canadian National Railway (CN) is the largest railway network in Canada and one of the largest in North America spanning over 20,000 route miles. CN transports goods across an integrated network linking the Atlantic and Pacific coasts with the Gulf of Mexico. CN offers shipper APIs, EDI integration, the eBusiness portal, and the CN ONE mobile app for shipment tracking, ordering, billing, and rate management.

providers.name: Stack AV
providers.description: Stack AV is a Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania autonomous-vehicle company founded in 2023 by Bryan Salesky (CEO), Peter Rander (President) and Brett Browning (CTO) — the leadership team behind Argo AI — and backed by SoftBank Group. The company develops AI-driven autonomy software and hardware for Class 8 commercial freight trucking, targeting driver shortages, vehicle uptime, safety, operating cost and emissions, and in May 2026 unveiled its first autonomous truck built in collaboration with PACCAR and Peterbilt Motors. Stack AV runs a public open-source engineering organization at github.com/stackav-oss (dltype, conch Triton kernels, clockwork, scene-tokens, push-guard, ai-workloads). It publishes no public developer program, API reference, or machine-readable API contract as of August 2026 — the product is an autonomous freight service, not a developer platform.

providers.name: ApniBus
providers.description: ApniBus is an India-based online bus ticket booking platform that lets travelers search routes, compare operators, select seats, and pay for tickets across government and private bus services. It positions itself as a leading Indian bus-booking marketplace and an official RSRTC (Rajasthan State Road Transport Corporation) booking partner, aggregating over one lakh bus services across thousands of routes. The consumer experience spans a website and Android/iOS apps, with UPI, cards, net banking, and wallet payments, instant e-ticket / m-ticket confirmation, live bus tracking, and easy cancellation. ApniBus was surfaced as a portfolio company of Version One Ventures and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment; it publishes no public developer or API program at this time.

providers.name: MagicBus
providers.description: MagicBus is a vanpool management platform that helps employers, HR teams, fleet managers, and transit agencies rebuild and operate employee commuting programs. Through its MagicRide app, riders, drivers, and coordinators book seats, form dynamic on-demand vanpools, and crowdsource new routes, while reporting dashboards supply the data needed for program evaluation and transit-subsidy applications. Surfaced as a mobility portfolio lead of Version One Ventures and Y Combinator, MagicBus publishes no public API or developer program at this time; this profile captures its verified public web surface.

providers.name: Snowman
providers.description: Snowman Logistics is an Indian integrated cold-chain and temperature-controlled logistics company headquartered in Bengaluru, providing refrigerated (frozen and chilled) warehousing, cold storage, and distribution services across India. It serves frozen and chilled foods, dairy, seafood, quick-service restaurants, pharmaceuticals, and other perishables through a national network of temperature-controlled warehouses and a refrigerated transportation fleet. The company is publicly listed on Indian exchanges and was surfaced as a portfolio company of Norwest Venture Partners. This profile was enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline; the enrichment pass confirmed the company publishes a marketing/corporate website (snowman.in) but exposes no public developer, API, or well-known discovery surface.

providers.name: National Transportation Safety Board
providers.description: The National Transportation Safety Board (NTSB) is an independent federal agency responsible for investigating transportation accidents, including those involving airplanes, trains, ships, and pipelines. The NTSB promotes safety and prevents future accidents by conducting thorough investigations and making recommendations to improve safety standards.

providers.name: Reibus International
providers.description: Reibus International is an Atlanta, Georgia headquartered technology company operating a digital marketplace and open-deck freight logistics platform for the industrial metals industry. Reibus connects buyers and sellers of steel and other industrial metals with a curated network of international and domestic carriers, offering instant freight quotes, automated carrier assignment, and real-time shipment visibility tracking. The Reibus Logistics platform specializes in flatbed, dry van, and dray transportation across the contiguous United States, Canada, and Mexico, plus specialized services including oversized loads, team drivers, expedited shipping, cross-border logistics, high-value freight, and warehousing. Founded by CEO John Blount, Reibus operates across seven countries with business relationships spanning more than 25 nations and is backed by Battery Ventures. Reibus does not currently publish a public developer API, OpenAPI specification, or developer portal; customer-facing tools (instant quote, shipment visibility dashboard) are delivered through the app.reibus.com web application.

providers.name: Clean Energy Fuels
providers.description: Clean Energy Fuels is a major US corporation and Fortune 1000 company. The Clean Energy Fuels API provides programmatic access to its platform services, data, and integrations for enterprise customers and partners.

providers.name: Rabbit Mobility
providers.description: Rabbit Mobility (Rabbit) is a clean-tech micro-mobility sharing company operating in Cairo and Giza, Egypt. Through its iOS and Android mobile apps, Rabbit offers shared standing electric scooters and electric bikes with two service models: on-demand "Unlock & Go" rides and multi-day "Day Rentals" that include delivery. The company reports covering more than one million kilometers and saving over 50 tons of CO2 emissions. Rabbit is a portfolio company of 500 Global. As a consumer mobile-app business, Rabbit publishes no public developer API, SDKs, or API documentation at this time; this profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network for discovery and enrichment.

providers.name: SkyDrive
providers.description: SkyDrive Inc. is a Japanese advanced air mobility manufacturer, founded in July 2018 by members of the CARTIVATOR volunteer project, that develops, manufactures, sells and operates eVTOL (electric vertical take-off and landing) aircraft. Its flagship aircraft, SKYDRIVE (model SD-05), is a compact three-seat electric aircraft in type certification with the Japan Civil Aviation Bureau and in concurrent validation with the US Federal Aviation Administration, and is produced with official manufacturing partner Suzuki Motor Corporation at Suzuki's plant in Iwata, Shizuoka. The company is headquartered in Toyota City, Aichi, with offices in Tokyo, Nagoya, Osaka and Yamaguchi and a US subsidiary, SkyDrive America. SkyDrive is a hardware and aircraft-operations company; it publishes no public developer program, API, SDK or machine-readable interface contract of any kind.

providers.name: Achates Power
providers.description: Achates Power is a San Diego, California engine technology company founded in 2004 by Dr. James Lemke and John Walton that develops opposed-piston, two-stroke compression-ignition engine architecture and licenses the resulting engine designs, development tools, simulation software and patents to engine manufacturers and OEMs. Its engines target passenger vehicles, medium and heavy-duty commercial trucks, military vehicles, and off-road and power-generation applications, and the company has claimed fuel-efficiency improvements of as much as 30 percent over conventional engines at comparable or better emissions. Achates Power has received U.S. Army TARDEC, Department of Energy and ARPA-E funding and partners with engine manufacturers such as Fairbanks Morse. It is a privately held hardware and engineering licensing business and publishes no public developer program, API, or machine-readable API artifacts.

providers.name: Passport
providers.description: Passport (Passport Labs) is a mobility management platform for cities, universities, and agencies, covering digital parking payments, enforcement, permits, and curbside management, and is used by 800+ agencies. Passport exposes a partner developer program at developer.passportinc.com whose REST APIs let parking apps, navigation apps, in-car infotainment, and mobility/POS systems create and stop parking sessions, quote and determine rates, bulk-export the parking environment (zones, spaces, rules), receive parking event schemas, and manage enforcement immobilizations. Rates and rules are configured once by Passport's customers and pushed to payment providers via API. Access is gated - partners register an application, are issued OAuth client credentials by Passport's identity provider, and only authenticated partner applications may call the public APIs. No SDK is required. Commercial terms are partnership / agency-contract based rather than publicly listed self-serve pricing.

providers.name: Cargo X
providers.description: Cargo X (CargoX) is a Sao Paulo based Brazilian logistics technology and fintech company, founded in 2013, that operates one of Brazil's largest digital freight marketplaces - matching shippers (embarcadores) with carriers (transportadoras) and independent truck drivers. Beyond freight brokerage the platform provides dedicated freight desk operations, driver qualification and real-time cargo monitoring, automated issuance of Brazilian transport tax documents (CT-e and MDF-e), cargo insurance, receivables financing and working-capital credit for carriers, and green-freight / ESG programs that reduce empty return trips. The company reached unicorn status with a USD 200M Series F in October 2021 co-led by Tencent and SoftBank, with Valor Capital Group, Lightrock and Oikos participating.

providers.name: JetZero
providers.description: JetZero is a Long Beach, California aerospace company founded in 2021 by Tom O'Leary and Mark Page to bring the blended wing body (all-wing) airframe to commercial aviation. Its flagship program is the Z4, a 250-seat, international-range jetliner the company says will burn up to 50% less fuel than comparable tube-and-wing airliners, and the Jet1 full-scale demonstrator being built with Scaled Composites in Mojave, California ahead of a first flight targeted for 2027. JetZero broke ground in 2026 on a manufacturing and final-assembly campus in Greensboro, North Carolina and is opening an engineering office in Wichita, Kansas at NIAR. It is backed by the U.S. Air Force, NASA, United Airlines, Alaska Star Ventures and a $175M Series B led by B Capital, with letters of intent from Gulf Air and Japan Airlines. JetZero is an aircraft manufacturer, not a software or data provider: as of this profile it publishes no public developer portal, no API documentation, no SDKs, and no machine-readable API contract of any kind. Its public technical surface is a supplier registration and supplier standards program.

providers.name: REGENT Craft
providers.description: REGENT Craft Inc. is a Rhode Island maritime mobility manufacturer building the Seaglider, an all-electric wing-in-ground-effect (WIG) vessel that floats on its hull, hydrofoils, and then flies within a wingspan of the water's surface at up to 180 mph. The company builds the 12-passenger Viceroy, the larger Monarch, and the uncrewed Squire defense drone, and operates a defense product line for ISR, contested logistics and MEDEVAC missions. REGENT is a vehicle manufacturer rather than a software company: it publishes no developer program, no public API and no machine-readable API contract. It does serve a real, hand-authored llms.txt at its website root, which is the only machine-readable artifact on its public surface.

providers.name: Werner Enterprises
providers.description: Werner Enterprises is a leading transportation and logistics company providing truckload transportation services, logistics solutions, and supply chain management throughout North America. Founded in 1956 and headquartered in Omaha, Nebraska, Werner operates one of the largest fleets in the United States and offers freight brokerage, dedicated carriage, intermodal, and final-mile delivery services through its Werner Bridge℠ digital freight platform.

providers.name: Bliq
providers.description: Bliq is a Berlin-based premium driverless-car subscription service rolling out across Europe. Instead of owning a car or paying per ride, members subscribe monthly to a private autonomous vehicle that Bliq charges, cleans, insures, maintains, and parks on their behalf. Cars are booked for time windows (hours or days) rather than single trips, every journey is remotely supervised by licensed local operators, and there is no surge pricing. Backed by Speedinvest, Bliq positions itself as "ownership without ownership." The company currently operates a consumer marketing site with early-access and waitlist flows and does not publish a public developer API, documentation, or SDKs.

providers.name: De-Ice
providers.description: De-Ice Technologies is a Somerville, Massachusetts deep-tech aviation startup building a chemical-free aircraft de-icing system that replaces conventional glycol spray with electrically heated strips applied to aircraft surfaces, removing snow and ice prior to takeoff. The technology eliminates weather-related departure delays, cuts glycol spraying costs, and reduces CO₂ emissions from idling fuel burn and chemical production. Named to Time's Best Inventions of 2024, De-Ice counts Air Canada as its launch customer and is backed by Techstars. This is a physical-hardware aviation company and does not currently publish a public developer API, documentation, or SDK surface.

providers.name: Plus
providers.description: Plus (PlusAI) develops AI-based autonomous driving technology for commercial trucks. Its flagship SuperDrive is an AI-powered Level 4 autonomous driving system, and HyperFoundry is an integrated development platform for Physical AI. Plus works through partnerships with truck OEMs including TRATON GROUP, Hyundai, and IVECO rather than shipping a public developer API. Backed by GGV Capital, the company was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio lead; this enrichment pass confirmed it exposes no public API, SDK, or developer portal surface, and captured its domain-security posture.

providers.name: Telgani
providers.description: Telgani is an app-based car rental aggregator founded in 2018 and headquartered in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. Its consumer iOS and Android apps let users compare prices and book cars from more than 50 partner rental companies with over 500 branches across the Kingdom, offering doorstep delivery, airport pickup, and daily, monthly, or yearly rentals. Backed by 500 Global, Impact46, and Elm, Telgani has raised roughly $8.5M across a seed round, a 2021 pre-Series A, and a 2023 Series A. Telgani operates as a consumer mobile marketplace and does not publish a public developer API program; this profile captures its public web properties (homepage, privacy policy, terms of service) and its domain security posture.

providers.name: Turo
providers.description: Turo is a San Francisco-headquartered peer-to-peer car sharing marketplace operating in the United States, Canada, the United Kingdom, France, and Australia. The platform lets vehicle owners (hosts) list their cars for rent and lets travelers (guests) book those vehicles directly through the Turo app or website, with Turo handling identity verification, insurance, protection plans, payments, and trust and safety on top of the host's inventory. The marketplace covers economy cars, SUVs, trucks, vans, exotic and classic vehicles, and EVs across more than 14,000 cities, and offers contactless Turo Go vehicles where supported. Turo's revenue model is a marketplace take-rate against each trip plus protection plan and ancillary fees, supported by an integrated host operations stack (calendar, pricing, messaging, and earnings) and a guest mobile and web booking experience. Turo does not currently expose a public developer API, SDK, or partner developer portal. The only third-party-facing surface was a now-deprecated ChatGPT plugin (chatgpt.turo.com) launched in 2023 and sunset alongside OpenAI's plugins program in 2024. Integrations with connected-car platforms such as Smartcar are negotiated directly rather than through self-serve developer onboarding, and Turo's public GitHub presence (github.com/turo, github.com/open-turo) is limited to internal engineering tooling, GitHub Actions, ESLint configs, and language-specific libraries rather than a public marketplace API.

providers.name: WeRide
providers.description: WeRide (NASDAQ: WRD) is an autonomous driving technology company founded in 2017 and headquartered in Guangzhou, China. It develops Level 4 self-driving technology across a portfolio of five core products — Robotaxi, Robobus, Robovan, Robosweeper (autonomous sanitation) and advanced driver-assistance systems (ADAS) — and operates its fleets in more than 40 cities across 12 countries. WeRide does not publish a public developer API, SDK, or developer portal; this profile captures the company's public web presence and domain-security posture as surfaced by the API Evangelist enrichment pipeline.

providers.name: 1hai
providers.description: eHi Car Rental (一嗨租车), operated by Shanghai eHi Information Technology Services Co., Ltd., is one of China's leading car rental and mobility companies. Founded in 2006 and headquartered in Shanghai, eHi offers self-drive car rentals, chauffeured car service, used-car sales, and corporate and government mobility programs across more than 500 cities nationwide, with cross-city return and airport pickup. eHi is a portfolio company of Qiming Venture Partners, added to the API Evangelist network as a company profile. The business operates consumer web and mobile (iOS, Android, HarmonyOS) booking channels; no public developer or API platform was found during enrichment.

providers.name: FREE NOW
providers.description: FREE NOW is one of Europe's leading multi-mobility "super apps," letting riders book taxis and private-hire vehicles and, in many cities, e-scooters, e-bikes, e-mopeds, carsharing and public-transport tickets from a single application. Founded in Hamburg in 2009 as mytaxi and rebranded FREE NOW in 2019, the company operates across nine European countries and 150+ cities. It ran as part of the YOUR NOW mobility joint venture between Mercedes-Benz and BMW and was acquired by Lyft. FREE NOW exposes a partner/business integration API (FREE NOW for Business) through a password-gated developer portal at developer.free-now.com, and maintains an active open-source presence — including the Wave design system — under the freenowtech GitHub organization.

providers.name: SilverRail
providers.description: SilverRail Technologies is a rail technology company that powers global rail ecommerce and distribution. Its platform spans journey planning, ticketing, and onboard information, aiming to transform the rail experience for travelers while making rail retail easier and more profitable for operators, travel agencies, and distributors. SilverRail connects rail carriers and sellers so rail inventory can be searched, booked, and ticketed across markets. The company was surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of Accel and Canaan Partners. As of this enrichment pass SilverRail runs a corporate marketing site (Next.js) but publishes no public developer portal, API reference, OpenAPI specification, SDKs, or /.well-known discovery documents; its API and distribution capabilities appear to be delivered through partner/enterprise integration rather than a self-serve public API.

providers.name: Terawatt Infrastructure
providers.description: Terawatt Infrastructure is a US infrastructure company that acquires, develops, owns, and operates purpose-built electric-vehicle charging centers for commercial fleets — medium- and heavy-duty trucking, drayage, autonomous vehicle and rideshare operators. The company sells charging-as-a-service rather than software: it holds real estate and grid interconnection, builds high-power charging sites (including the I-10 electrified corridor and sites near the Ports of Los Angeles and Long Beach), and runs them with its own proprietary Charge Management Software, operations and maintenance program, and a customer reservations portal. Terawatt states publicly that it has implemented the Open Charge Point Interface (OCPI) with custom extensions so fleet customers get visibility into its charging facilities, but it publishes no public developer portal, API reference, or machine-readable contract for that surface.

providers.name: AI Fleet
providers.description: Aifleet (aifleet.com) is a technology-driven, full-stack trucking carrier founded in 2020 and headquartered in Austin, Texas. The company describes itself as the first full-stack, AI-driven carrier, pairing company drivers with proprietary AI algorithms and its own Transportation Management System (TMS) to optimize truck utilization, routing, load matching, fuel usage, and scheduling across the roughly $400B U.S. freight sector. Aifleet emphasizes a driver-centric model — better pay, predictable schedules, and reduced wait times — alongside shipper-facing services with proactive tracking updates and predictive ETAs. It has raised roughly $50M since founding (Series A 2021, venture round 2023, Series B 2024) from investors including Obvious Ventures, Ibex Investors, Volvo Group Venture Capital, Compound, and Heron Rock. Aifleet is a logistics service provider rather than a developer-facing API platform; as of this profile it publishes no public API, developer portal, SDKs, or OpenAPI definition.

providers.name: AutoChilango
providers.description: AutoChilango (Auto Chilango) is a Mexico City-based mobile application that consolidates the everyday services drivers in CDMX and the State of Mexico need into a single app. It covers the "Hoy No Circula" driving-restriction calendar, vehicular verification schedules, traffic fines (multas) lookup and payment, annual registration (tenencia), insurance, parking, gas stations, and mechanical services for private cars, motorcycles, taxis, and special plates. Backed by 500 Global and added to the API Evangelist network as a company profile; no public developer/API surface has been found, so this profile captures the provider's identity, information surface (blog, FAQs, privacy), and probed domain security.

providers.name: Go X
providers.description: Go X is an electric micromobility sharing company that lets riders rent scooters, e-bikes, and cars on demand, 24/7, through a consumer mobile app. Operating in cities such as New Orleans, Go X builds its own connected electric vehicles and manages fleet access, unlocking, ride sessions, and payments entirely in-app on iOS and Android. It is a consumer-facing mobility service rather than a public API provider: it exposes no developer portal, documentation, SDKs, or documented public API surface (its api.goxapp.com host is the private backend for the mobile apps).

providers.name: ISAAC Instruments
providers.description: ISAAC Instruments is a Canadian provider of in-cab technology and fleet management for the trucking industry - electronic logging devices (ELD), telematics, hours-of-service (HOS) compliance, driver workflow, messaging, and fuel/performance analytics, delivered as a fully managed hardware-plus-software platform. ISAAC runs an "Open Platform" with a documented API that lets fleets and 80+ integration partners (TMS/dispatch, maintenance, fuel tax, visibility, safety/compliance) share ISAAC data with their chosen vendors. API access is partner-gated - vendors apply through the ISAAC partner program and the full API Guide and reference live behind the ISAAC InRealTime portal and Client Center rather than on a public developer site. The API surface documented here is modeled from ISAAC's public platform and partner materials; exact endpoints, base URLs, and authentication are provisioned to approved partners.

providers.name: Upshift
providers.description: Upshift is a San Francisco fractional car subscription service — "a 2-car garage, in your pocket." Members choose 4, 8, or 12 driving days a month and get a premium Toyota hybrid delivered clean, fueled, insured, and maintained, then picked up when they are done, with plans from $399/month including insurance, delivery, and maintenance. A 500 Global and URBAN-X portfolio company, Upshift publishes no public developer program or API surface; the member experience runs through its iOS/Android apps and go.upshiftcars.com.

providers.name: Gatik
providers.description: Gatik is an autonomous trucking company founded in 2017 by Gautam Narang, Arjun Narang and Apeksha Kumavat, headquartered in Silicon Valley, California. Gatik builds and operates the Gatik Driver, an SAE Level 4 autonomy system purpose-built for the middle mile: short-haul, repeatable freight routes between distribution centers, dark stores and retail endpoints. Gatik runs driverless medium-duty box trucks in commercial service for Fortune 50 retailers and grocers including Walmart, Loblaw, Kroger, Tyson Foods, Pitney Bowes and PepsiCo, across Texas, Arkansas, Arizona, Ontario and other North American markets. The company partners with Isuzu, Ryder, Goodyear and NVIDIA, runs the Gatik Arena simulation platform, and publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI specification, SDK or developer portal — its surface is a corporate marketing site plus a legacy archive site carrying about, safety, news, careers and legal pages.

Volteum is a Techstars portfolio company and publishes no public developer portal; its telematics and fleet-system API integrations are offered to customers directly.

providers.name: APX
providers.description: APX (APX Logistics Solutions) is a Southeast Asian less-than-truckload (LTL) digital logistics platform headquartered in Bangkok, with operations in Thailand, Malaysia, and Singapore. It positions itself as the region's first LTL digital logistics provider, offering domestic and cross-border shipping, international sea and air freight, customs brokerage, warehousing and distribution, project logistics, and heavy-lift/breakbulk services. Its proprietary technology platform provides online shipment booking, real-time tracking with ETA notifications, digital proof-of-delivery, AI-assisted route optimization, a driver app, and analytics dashboards including CO2/ESG reporting. APX is a portfolio company of 500 Global and was added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. As of this enrichment pass APX publishes no first-party public developer API, SDKs, or developer portal; shipment tracking is currently integrable only via third-party aggregators.

Ampaire is backed by Techstars and has worked with partners including NASA and ARPA-E. providers.name: Dayjob
providers.description: Dayjob is an AI-powered scheduling agent built for waste management and skip hire fleets, operated by Gaea Technology Ltd and backed by Y Combinator (Spring 2026). Its autonomous agents analyze millions of potential route combinations to build optimized daily schedules that factor in travel times, skip sizes, driver availability and priority job assignments, then continuously re-optimize in real time as new jobs, driver changes and exceptions arrive. Dayjob integrates with existing ERP and telematics systems (Weighsoft, PurGo, Wastelogics, plus custom report setups) and claims customers see revenue and efficiency gains, tighter time-window hit rates and materially less planning admin. ZIM operates in more than 90 countries, serving over 30,000 customers across more than 300 ports worldwide with a differentiated global-niche strategy focused on agile fleet management and select trade lanes. It ingests and normalizes shipment data from TMS and WMS systems (CargoWise, Descartes, homegrown systems) via private API, file drop (FTP/SFTP), and database sync, so providers can differentiate on digital visibility. Logixboard exposes no public developer API; integrations are delivered as bespoke, provider-scoped data connections. providers.name: Drivezy
providers.description: Drivezy — founded in Bengaluru, India in 2015 and originally launched as JustRide — operated a peer-to-peer vehicle-sharing and self-drive rental marketplace covering cars, motorcycles and scooters, pairing a company-operated fleet with vehicles listed by individual owners. It raised venture funding through a Series B and held acquisition talks with Yamaha. Drivezy never ran a public developer program: no portal, no API reference and no machine-readable contract were ever published. The /api/* endpoints visible in archived captures of secure.drivezy.com were the private backend of its consumer mobile app. As of 2026-08-12 drivezy.com does not resolve: the registry still delegates it to Cloudflare nameservers, but those nameservers answer REFUSED, so every lookup returns SERVFAIL. The domain had already left the company before it went dark — Internet Archive captures show the real site through mid-2024, a bare WordPress shell through 2025, and unrelated Indonesian gambling SEO spam from December 2025 until the final capture on 2026-05-11 — so a drivezy.com that resolves again should not be read as this company without fresh evidence. What remains public is the github.com/drivezy organization and thirteen packages on Packagist and npm — internal Laravel and JavaScript platform libraries, not API client SDKs.

providers.name: Anda
providers.description: Anda (andaafrica.com) is an Angolan mobility and delivery company that operates ride-hailing and courier services using motorcycles, electric motorcycles, and tuk-tuks, integrating technology, finance, and sustainability to serve people and businesses across Angola. Anda runs a drive-to-own model that empowers drivers to own their vehicles through training (ANDA Academia), insurance, maintenance support, and safe operating hubs, turning informal transport work into stable livelihoods. Moto-taxi rides are fulfilled through the Yango app, alongside green electric-motorcycle options, tuk-tuk transport, and express delivery. The company is based in Talatona, Angola, and is a portfolio company of Speedinvest (invested 2025). Anda does not currently publish any public API or developer documentation; this profile captures the verified company identity and domain-security posture.

The platform lets car owners list vehicles to earn recurring returns while giving travelers on-demand access to a curated fleet at competitive daily rates. Headquartered in Jeddah, Esar is an early-stage startup backed by 500 Global and the Taqadam accelerator. This API Evangelist profile tracks the company as a portfolio lead; no public developer API surface has been found to date.

providers.name: omio

Omio does not publish a public developer API or developer portal; its carrier and distribution integrations are handled through private B2B partnerships. This profile was added to the API Evangelist network from VC-portfolio discovery and enriched by probing Omio's public domain, DNS, and security surface.

providers.name: Spotangels
providers.description: SpotAngels is a consumer parking application that helps drivers find free and cheap parking, understand and avoid confusing street-parking rules, get reminders before street cleaning and permit-zone changes, and book discounted garage and lot parking in major cities. The company also runs business programs for cities, universities, and parking operators/owners to surface availability and deals. SpotAngels is a Y Combinator-backed company. As of this enrichment pass it exposes no public developer API, developer portal, SDK, or machine-readable API surface; its integrations are business partnerships rather than developer-facing APIs.

providers.name: Onramp Payments
providers.description: Onramp Payments, Inc. (ONRAMP) is a fintech company building modern payments infrastructure for the commercial trucking and fleet industry. Founded by logistics and payments veterans and backed by Canaan Partners, the company operates an enterprise-grade digital platform that replaces legacy card-based fleet payment systems. For carriers it offers cardless fuel payments at the pump, administrative spend controls, and maintenance payment solutions; for merchants it provides digital payment acceptance, pricing controls, and fraud prevention that work both in-store and at fuel pumps; and for partners it offers API integrations, broker solutions, and Transportation Management System (TMS) connections. The company markets itself as the easiest, most secure payments platform for carriers and merchants and has raised roughly $21M from investors including Canaan Partners, CEAS Investments, Contour Venture Partners, Javelin Venture Partners, and RedBlue Capital. As of this enrichment pass ONRAMP publishes no public developer portal, API reference, SDKs, or OpenAPI, so this profile captures verified company identity and probed domain-security posture only.

providers.name: Catch that bus
providers.description: Catch That Bus (catchthatbus.com) is a Malaysian / Southeast Asian online bus and coach ticket booking platform, surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and added to the API Evangelist network as a lead for enrichment. Live domain probes on 2026-07-18 show the website resolves over TLS 1.3 but the origin returns HTTP 522 (Cloudflare origin unreachable), and no public developer portal, documentation, OpenAPI, SDK, or other machine-readable API surface was discoverable at the time of this pass.

providers.name: Drivemate
providers.description: Drivemate is a peer-to-peer car-sharing and car-rental marketplace based in Bangkok, Thailand, founded in 2016. The platform lets vehicle owners list their cars and lets travelers and residents rent directly from those owners through the Drivemate mobile app and website, handling booking, verification, insurance and payments end to end. Drivemate operates one of the largest car-rental selections in Thailand with more than 3,000 vehicles across 35 provinces and a community of over 100,000 users, and has raised Series A funding from investors including 500 Global (500 Startups), NetSol, Isuzu UNT and Colopl Next. This API Evangelist profile tracks the company's public digital and developer surface; Drivemate is a consumer mobility marketplace and does not currently publish a public developer API program, so this record captures identity, distribution and domain-security signals rather than API specifications.

providers.name: Fluid Truck
providers.description: Fluid Truck was a Denver, Colorado peer-to-peer commercial vehicle sharing platform founded in 2016 by James Eberhard and Jenifer Snyder, often described as "the Zipcar of commercial vehicles". It operated an app-based, self-service rental marketplace for cargo vans, box trucks and flatbeds across roughly 400 cities in 32 US states, and ran the Fluid Vehicle Investor Program (FVIP) through which individuals and small businesses bought fleets that Fluid managed and rented out. The company raised over $80 million in venture funding, filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy in Delaware in October 2024 after an $20.6 million cash loss in 2023, sold substantially all assets to Kingbee Rentals in December 2024, and the case converted to Chapter 7 liquidation in September 2025. The company is wound down: no developer program, API documentation, or machine-readable contract was ever published, and its own web properties no longer serve a valid TLS certificate.

providers.name: LimoFind
providers.description: LimoFind is a United States consumer marketplace and quote-request service for ground transportation rentals — limousines, party buses, charter buses, sprinter buses, mini buses and shuttle buses — connecting travelers with local operators near them. The site runs an instant online quote funnel organized by occasion (weddings, proms, airport transfers, corporate travel, bachelor and bachelorette parties, birthdays, concerts and sporting events, funerals, wine tasting tours, nights out) and by vehicle class, backed by a large set of state and city landing pages covering major metropolitan markets across the country. LimoFind is a WordPress-published consumer property with a blog covering rental costs and booking guidance; it publishes no public developer program, API, SDK or documentation surface.

providers.name: Lori Systems
providers.description: Lori Systems is a Nairobi-headquartered, pan-African digital freight platform that matches cargo owners with vetted transporters to coordinate long-haul trucking across the continent. Founded in 2016 by Josh Sandler, Jean-Claude Homawoo, and Ernest Gichini Ngaruiya, the company is now led by CEO Uche Ogboi and runs operations from offices in Kenya, Nigeria, and Uganda, moving cargo across roughly 12 African countries with a network of 20,000+ trucks and over $10B of cargo facilitated. The platform offers shippers instant rate estimates, load matching, real-time shipment tracking, electronic proof of delivery, and integrated payments, while giving transporters access to cargo orders, truck-availability management, and prompt payment on delivery. Lori operates a public rate-card tool at ratecard.lorisystems.com, but does not publish a public developer API, SDK, or open OpenAPI specification; its GitHub organization is limited to small internal-tooling repositories (a Singer.io tap for Freshsales, a BambooHR Python client, a Kubernetes Terraform provider, and similar utilities) rather than a customer-facing API surface.
